Quick thread 🧵
1) Inventory the Vercel project: env vars, build settings, the domain, and its current DNS records.
2) Two days out, drop your DNS TTL so the switch propagates in minutes, not hours.
3) Deploy to the new server and test everything on the temporary URL.
4) Add your domain and SSL on the new box, then change the DNS record while Vercel stays live.
